specs.title: Embeddable booking widget
specs.why: Merchants with an existing website convert better booking in place than being sent elsewhere.
specs.scope: Script tag and iframe widget the business can embed on their own site. CSP-safe, theme-aware and responsive.
tasks: Docs page with a copy-paste snippet
acceptance: It works on a plain HTML page
An Axe audit passes with zero critical issues

specs.title: Observability
specs.why: Agent and payment failures are invisible without tracing, and invisible failures are what kill trust.
specs.scope: Structured logging, distributed tracing across agent tool calls, dashboards for booking conversion, message delivery, payment success rate and agent tool error rate. Runbook link attached to each alert.
tasks: JSON logger with request and tenant IDs
Dashboards for the four key metrics
acceptance: An agent tool call appears as a span
At least one alert fires in a synthetic failure test
